extraction.notes: Pre-2020 document used only for RI-FMW-001 under LIM-0027. Not used for RI-TEC-028. Marked MD 156/15 with no LIMITE marking; published on the Commission enlargement site. The cover date reads "[date]". EURES, social security, EHIC and supplementary pension passages are outside the named issue. The report says the 2014 clause "will enter into force on the date of accession"; it does not show whether the clause survives in the law today.
